Cen_HOD, Sat_HOD). Evaluated every 0.01 dex over the fit range <N> = 10^-1 ... 10^1.5 (appendix) and inside the measured halo-mass range; below M_cut the satellite term is set to zero (the printed power law is undefined there). The fit is to the measured HOD with jackknife errors from 27 sub-volumes (parameter errors in the table are not propagated).

records.notes: Verified against the measured curve of the paper's figure (digitized): rms 0.013, max 0.028 dex over 13 points of the fit range; table internal consistency M_1/M_min = 10^(log M_1 - log M_min) reproduces the tabulated ratio to 2 per cent.
